files.content:
# Offline Pixel Task List

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, network, or build step required.

## Features
- Add tasks by typing and clicking Add or pressing Enter.
- Blank input is ignored after trimming.
- Pixel-style CSS with hard borders and shadows.
- Total and remaining counts update instantly and stay integer-only.
- Toggle checkboxes to mark tasks done.
- Delete buttons remove individual tasks.
- First task gets IDs `todo-text-1`, `todo-check-1`, `todo-delete-1`.
- State is kept in memory only; refreshing clears tasks.

## Files
- `index.html` – page structure and labels
- `styles.css` – pixel-style visual design
- `script.js` – in-memory task state and DOM updates
- `README.md` – this file

phases.name: Scaffold and static UI
tasks: Create root index.html with labeled todo input id todo-input, add button id todo-add, total count element #todo-total, remaining count element #remaining, and empty task list container
Create styles.css with pixel-style visual design for controls, task rows, checkboxes, and delete buttons
Ensure all controls are keyboard-accessible and use addEventListener, not inline handlers
Set initial text content of #todo-total and #remaining to integer-only 0

phases.name: Task creation and dynamic ID rendering
tasks: Add click listener to todo-add and keyboard support for Enter key
Trim input text and ignore blank input
Create first task with span id todo-text-1, checkbox id todo-check-1, delete button id todo-delete-1
Maintain in-memory array for tasks and generate increasing numeric IDs for new tasks
Render new tasks into the task list container using DOM APIs

phases.name: Toggle, delete, and count updates
tasks: Update total task count in #todo-total when adding or deleting tasks
Update incomplete count in #remaining when checkbox is toggled or task is deleted
Ensure counts remain integer-only and reflect current in-memory state
Implement delete button removal of task row and state entry

phases.name: README and acceptance validation
tasks: Write README.md with run instructions, feature list, and file structure
Verify no imports, packages, network requests, external assets, iframes, or server code
Check total source lines across HTML/CSS/JS are under 240
Test full acceptance flow: add, blank input ignored, toggle updates remaining, delete updates both counts

risks: Source line count may exceed 240 while implementing styling and accessibility
Dynamic ID generation may collide if not tracked carefully in memory
DOM state and in-memory array could become out of sync during rapid add/delete operations
Keyboard accessibility may require extra markup or labels that increase line count
